chunks: "Throw it down, O Moses," said (the Voice).
ai.seo_question: What did God command Moses to do with his staff in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Taa-Haa, this command emphasizes the immediacy of divine authority as Moses (AS) prepares to confront Pharaoh's arrogance, serving as a tangible proof (burhan) for the skeptical court. Shia exegetes often highlight this moment as a demonstration of how God empowers the chosen prophet with clear signs to validate his mission against earthly kingship.
